shared_elements: curvilinear carved outlines in low relief
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic anthropomorphic imagery rendered as smooth, rounded carved lines, and both include simple circular/ring motifs and arcing bands, but these are generic devices that any carving tradition could reach independently. A depicts a crowded multi-figure scene of small stick-like bodies with raised arms crossed by long straight lines, whereas B is a single massive frontal head-and-torso figure whose surface bears isolated, symmetrically placed abstract signs (ring, girdle-like band, paired curls) with no interacting figures.
